حقتا (form I)
# حَقَّتَا (ḥaqqatā) /ħaq.qa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# حُقَّتَا (ḥuqqatā) /ħuq.qa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa) and حُقَّ (ḥuqqa)
